blocks.en: F.2 Measurement Method
blocks.zh: F.2 计量方法

blocks.en:
Each pack length and window budget define a paired experiment.
Both variants receive 5 warmups and 20 measured trials; successive pairs alternate between whole-pack → \rightarrow windowed and windowed → \rightarrow whole-pack order, yielding 240 measured samples.
Each window budget has an independently measured whole-pack baseline, accounting for the small baseline-time differences between rows at the same length.
blocks.zh:
每个包长和窗口预算定义一个对齐的实验.
两个变体都得到5个热量和20个测量试验;连续对子在整件中交替排列 → 右侧的窗口和窗口 → 右侧的整件订单,产生240个测量样品.
每个窗口预算都有一个独立计量的全包基线,核算行间长度相同的小基线时间差异.

blocks.en:
CUDA events measure forward-plus-backward (F+B) time, including block execution, inner products of the output and final state with fixed cotangents, and backward through the scalar objective.
Input preparation, schedule construction, and compilation occur outside the timed region.
Peak memory is PyTorch peak allocated, including block parameters, inputs and cotangents, outputs, gradients, and both prepared schedules.
This metric measures live tensor allocations, distinct from memory reserved by the caching allocator.
The main table reports medians; percentage changes are computed from unrounded medians.
blocks.zh:
CUDA事件测量前加后加(F+B)时间,包括块执行,输出和最终状态的内产物有固定的cotangent,并通过scalar目标后退.
投入准备、时间表构建和汇编发生在定时区域之外。
峰值内存是分配的PyTorch峰值,包括块参数,输入和cotangent,输出,梯度,以及两个已编制的时间表.
这个度量衡是活的百分率分配,不同于缓存分配器保留的内存.
主要表格报告中位数;百分比变化是根据未四舍五入的中位数计算的。

blocks.en: F.3 Full Results
blocks.zh: F.3 全部结果

blocks.en:
Table 15 : Full memory and time results for the MoS memory block.
Each row is an independently measured whole-pack/window pair; values are medians.
blocks.zh:
表15:MOS内存区块的全部内存和时间结果.
每行是独立测量的全包/窗对;值为中位数.

blocks.en:
As pack length increases from 8K to 32K, whole-pack peak memory grows from 12.37 GiB to 47.83 GiB, while 4096-token windows grow from 8.36 GiB to 9.49 GiB.
Windowing bounds the lifetime of projections and intermediates, while retained outputs and boundary states still grow with length.
Across the three lengths, the median time increases for 4096-token windows are 15.0%, 11.1%, and 1.6%, respectively, showing that windowing overhead depends on the workload.
blocks.zh:
随着包长度从8K增加到32K,全包峰内存从12.37吉B增加到47.83吉B,而4096托肯窗则从8.36吉B增加到9.49吉B.
窗口限制预测和中间体的寿命,而保留的产出和边界状态仍然随着长度的增加而增加。
从三个长度来看,4096个托盘窗口的中间时间分别增加15.0%、11.1%和1.6%,这表明窗口管理费取决于工作量。

blocks.en: F.4 Measurement Variability
blocks.zh: F.4 计量可变性

blocks.en: Table 16 reports medians, interquartile intervals [Q25, Q75], and sample standard deviations, all in ms.
blocks.zh: 表16报告中位数,间距[Q25,Q75],以及样本标准差,均以毫秒计.

blocks.en:
Table 16 : F+B timing variability in milliseconds.
Intervals are the 25th and 75th percentiles; standard deviations use all measured samples.
blocks.zh:
表16:F+B计时变量,以毫秒计.
中间是25和75百分位数;标准偏差使用所有测量的样本.

blocks.en:
All samples are retained, including whole-pack trials at 16K/2048 (378.03 ms) and 32K/2048 (562.40 ms), and a windowed trial at 32K/4096 (640.58 ms).
The 1.6% reported in the chapter therefore describes the median time difference; individual trials exhibit variability.
blocks.zh:
所有样品都保留下来,包括16K/2048(378.03ms)和32K/2048(562.40ms)的全包试验和32K/4096(640.58ms)的窗口试验。
因此,该章中报告的1.6%说明了中位时间差;个别试验显示出变化。

blocks.en: Appendix G Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录G 案例研究

blocks.en: We present four examples from a long English conversation. They show how MemT-1.0-Nano uses its memory as the history grows.
blocks.zh: 我们从英语长篇对话中举出四个例子。 他们展示了MemT-1.0-Nano如何随着历史的发展而使用它的记忆.

blocks.en:
MemT-1.0-Nano keeps one latent memory slot for each conversation. History enters the slot through commit operations. A commit reads the incoming turns and writes their content into the slot, and the original text is not carried forward.
What the model can answer therefore depends on the writes. The examples below show this at four points in the conversation.
The text inside each box is given exactly as the model produced it.
blocks.zh:
MemT-1.0-Nano为每次对话保留一个潜在的内存槽. 历史通过承诺操作进入槽. 承诺读取即将到来的转折并将其内容写入插槽,原稿不向前传.
因此,模型的答案取决于文字。 下面的例子在谈话的四点上表明了这一点.
每个框内的文字与模型生成的文字完全相同.

blocks.zh: G.1 例1: 事实召回4K

The colour of the sample book is not mentioned, which is correct because the question does not ask for it.
blocks.zh: 问问三事:城,行之宗旨,谁持样本书. 模型给了所有三个。 还将附近的细节保留在他们的主人身上,因此宁波,红色的工具箱,蓝色的徽章都不向陈伟移动. 未提及样本书的颜色,这是正确的,因为问题并不要求.

blocks.en: The fictional page of the notebook gives two chained rules. A blue badge grants eligibility to book a room. Eligibility to book, together with completed registration, grants eligibility to collect a silver toolbox. The second rule therefore depends on both conditions. If the registration condition is dropped, the rule grants an entitlement that the text never gives. The answer below applies the chain correctly to both characters. It also keeps the two fictional colleagues apart, so Xu Cheng’s incomplete registration does not move to Chen Wei.
blocks.zh: 笔记本的虚构页面给出了两个连锁规则. 蓝色的徽章允许预订房间的资格. 预订资格,以及已完成的登记,都给予领取银色工具箱的资格。 因此,第二项规则取决于这两个条件。 如果取消登记条件,该规则赋予了案文从未给予的权利。 以下答案将链条正确应用到两个字符上. 也使两个虚构的同僚相隔不开,因此徐程的不完全注册并未移到陈伟.

blocks.en: G.4 Example 4: Tracking an Update at 64K

blocks.en: The exhibition is first set for Saturday at 3 p.m. in the East Hall. It is then officially changed to Sunday at 4 p.m. The venue, the admission price, and the contact person all stay the same. A move to Monday is also proposed, but it is never decided. A correct answer must report the change and leave the proposal out. The answer below does both. It answers the second half of the question by negation instead of repeating the values. The conversation runs for 508 more turns after the change, and the model still separates a settled change from a passing suggestion.
blocks.zh: 展览首定周六下午3时在东厅. 然后于下午4时正式改为星期日. 地点,录取价格,联系人一律不变. 也提议搬至星期一,但从未决定。 正确的答案必须报告变化,而不提建议。 下面的答案是两者兼而有之。 它通过否定而不是重复价值观来回答问题的后半部分。 对话在更改后再跑508转,模型仍然将一个已解决的更改与一个通过的建议分开.
